title: Decide with Jev: Make Failed AI Requests Safe in Laravel
content:
If an AI request fails, the old result should not stay on the screen looking like a pass. In episode 5 of Decide with Jev, every failed check becomes a new run marked needs review, and bad input stops in PHP before it reaches the model.

The post Decide with Jev: Make Failed AI Requests Safe in Laravel appeared first on Laravel News.
